name: Tastoria Recipe Manager
author: wpwebguru

sections.description:
Tastoria Recipe Manager is a powerful yet easy-to-use recipe plugin that helps you create, organize, and share beautiful recipes on your WordPress site. Whether you’re a food blogger, chef, or cooking enthusiast, Tastoria Recipe Manager provides everything you need to showcase your recipes professionally.

Key Features

📝 Custom Recipe Post Type
Dedicated recipe post type with all the fields you need for professional recipe management.

🔧 Dynamic Ingredients & Instructions
Add, remove, and reorder ingredients and steps. Include tips, images, and notes for each step.

📁 Advanced Taxonomies
Organize recipes by categories, cuisines, dietary preferences, and cooking methods.

🎨 Multiple Layout Styles
Choose from Classic, Modern, or Retro Tastoria Recipe Manager layouts to match your website’s aesthetic.

⭐ User Ratings & Reviews
Allow users to rate recipes and leave reviews. Display average ratings and review counts with AJAX submission.

🔍 AJAX Filtering
Filter recipes by categories, cuisines, dietary needs, and cooking methods without page reload.

📊 Nutrition Facts
Complete nutrition information panel for health-conscious recipes.

🎬 Video Support
Embed YouTube, Vimeo, or upload your own cooking videos.

📋 Shortcodes
Flexible shortcodes for grids, filters, and recipe displays anywhere on your site.

🔎 SEO Optimized
Built-in Schema.org markup for rich snippets in search results.

🌐 Translation Ready
Fully translatable with .pot file included.

Shortcodes

  • [tastrema_grid] – Display a grid of all recipes with pagination
  • [tastrema_filter] – Display AJAX-powered filter form

Example Usage:
[tastrema_grid columns=”4″ posts_per_page=”12″]
[tastrema_filter show_categories=”yes” show_cuisines=”yes”]

Perfect For

  • Food blogs and recipe websites
  • Cooking schools and culinary sites
  • Restaurant menu displays
  • Personal recipe collections
  • Health and nutrition blogs
  • Meal planning websites

Additional Information

Credits

Tastoria Recipe Manager is created with love for food bloggers and recipe enthusiasts. Thank you for using Tastoria Recipe Manager!

Support

For documentation, bug reports, and feature requests, please visit the Tastoria Recipe Manager menu in your WordPress admin.

Contributing

Tastoria Recipe Manager is open-source software. Contributions are welcome!

Translations

Tastoria Recipe Manager is translation ready. You can translate it into your language using the .pot file included in the languages folder.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tastoria-recipe-manager folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Tastoria Recipe Manager → Settings to configure your preferences
  4. Start adding recipes from the Tastoria Recipe Manager menu in your admin sidebar
sections.faq:
How do I display recipes on my site?

Use the [tastrema_grid] shortcode on any page or post. You can also use [tastrema_filter] for a complete recipe directory.

Can users rate recipes?

Yes! Users can leave star ratings and written reviews. Ratings appear in the recipe page and are used for schema markup.

How do I add nutrition information?

When editing a recipe, scroll to the Nutrition Information meta box and fill in the values. These will display in the sidebar on the frontend.

Can I add videos to recipes?

Yes! You can add YouTube, Vimeo URLs or upload your own video files in the Recipe Video meta box.

Is the plugin mobile-friendly?

Yes! Tastoria Recipe Manager is fully responsive and works perfectly on all devices including desktops, tablets, and smartphones.

Does it work with page builders?

Yes, Tastoria Recipe Manager works with any WordPress theme and page builder. Use the shortcodes to display recipes anywhere.

How do I change the layout style?

Go to Tastoria Recipe Manager → Settings and select your preferred layout style from Classic, Modern, or Retro Tastoria.

Can users leave reviews without logging in?

Yes, you can allow guest reviews in WordPress discussion settings. Guest reviewers need to provide their name and email.

Does it support Schema markup for SEO?

Yes! Tastoria Recipe Manager adds complete JSON-LD schema markup to all recipe pages for better search engine visibility.
